description:
WHY JOIN ALO? 

 Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

 OVERVIEW 

 The Product Development Department is looking for a dedicated, driven, and inspired individual to join the Alo family. This role will be instrumental in developing elevated studio to street styles, and building alo’s speed to market pipeline. The ideal candidate will have an apparel education and background, with an understanding of garment construction and calendar management. This is a fast-paced environment, the ability to multitask, creatively problem solve, and work under tight deadlines daily is a must.

 RESPONSIBILITIES    

 
 Lead the development process from concept through production, ensuring garments meet the highest standards of quality , fit and construction

 Leverage an extensive network of global suppliers to optimize lead times, ensure cost efficiency, and uphold impeccable quality standards

 Collaborate with design, technical, and production teams to maintain the integrity of each piece from prototype to final product

 Manage vendor relationships, negotiating costs, MOQs, and timelines while maintaining strong communication for seamless development

 Self-starter with the ability to work independently and react quickly to changes

 Understand and manage calendar deadlines

 Manage style level vendor allocation and seasonal WIPs

 Maintain PLM system General Style page, BOM (Bill Of Material) and Cost Sheets

 Analyze costing data and reporting to ensure margin goals are met

 Work with on-site PLM Developers on system advancements

 Close working relationship with Design, Tech Design, Raw Materials, Production, Color teams

 Attend fit sessions

 
 QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

 5+ years of experience in the apparel industry

 Self-starter, ability to multi-task and manage multiple projects on an ongoing basis

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 Excellent organizational and time management skills with appropriate sense of urgency

 Commitment and superior attention to detail

 Ability to work in a team environment, build trust and relationships with vendor & company staff

 Strong analytical skills

 Thorough understanding of testing protocol, product integrity requirements, product cycle timeline and garment construction

 Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work environment

 Strong interpersonal and listening skills

 Proficient in Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, & Outlook

 Proficiency with PLM

 
 The base salary range for this position is $90,000-$110,000 per year which represents the current range for the base salary for this exempt position. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. As such, on occasion and when applicable, there is the possibility that the final, agreed-upon base salary may be outside of the upper end of the range. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company’s total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits.
